verdict.rationale: Gram explicitly claims team-, server-, and tool-level permissions enforced through RBAC and OAuth 2.1 and synced to the enterprise IdP. It also describes an approved-tool catalog provisioned by team and role, and blocks unsanctioned shadow MCP servers by default. A vendor-published MoonPay case says permissions were scoped per server, per tool, and per team, and access control extends to proxied third-party servers. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how per-tool allowlists or policies are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing and the README.
